Gothic 1 Remake
Announcement
Gothic 1 Remake | Thank You Message

Check out the special message from Alkimia Interactive – rest assured, the team is in it for the long run. You can expect new features for Gothic 1 Remake in the next couple of months:

  • A photo mode to capture the beauty of the Valley of Mines;

  • Marvin Mode – the Gothic equivalent of a developer mode, think spawning creatures or items, teleporting around the map, or doing some silly things;

  • A mod kit to let you, the players, get creative with the game;

  • Alternative progression mechanics.

And do you think we didn't hear all the questions about the next game? We did, but our answer will take some time... We might actually answer it during the THQ Nordic Showcase 2027. This adventure is far from over, so stay with us!

Watch the new trailer: https://youtu.be/UFQ8EMaV_M4

Eco
Announcement
Hotfix 14.0.2 released!
Hey Citizens,

we have just released Hotfix 14.0.2 with the following changes:

Balance:

  • Changed: Yield for Composite Lumber, Flat Steel and Framed Glass was increased by 2.

  • Changed: Yield for Ashlar Stone was increased by 1.

  • Fixed: Some tables incorrectly required a Smelting Basic Upgrade instead of the Smelting Upgrade.

  • Fixed: Upgrade modules had no weight.

Gameplay:

  • Fixed: When cancelling a craft order that used items with a durability value of 200 due to talent, the refund of those items into a stockpile would turn all items it stacked with into "broken" state.

  • Fixed: A problem where a deed owned by a title couldn't be edited by its title holders until the server was restarted.

  • Fixed: Picked up objects kept the previous owner's bank account settings when placed down by another player.

UI:

  • Fixed: Recipes in a workstation were not clickable when the list was currently filtered due to a search.

  • Fixed: Currency, Settlement and Store links in the Economy Viewer couldn't be clicked when the window was resized.

  • Fixed: The star cost in the skill ui could be different between the list on the left and the selected specialty on the right, with one of them showing a wrong value.

  • Fixed: Purchased items going into the carry slot would display "Unknown" as location for the notification.

  • Fixed: Some test data for modules remained, leading to some modules showing weird information like having a power requirement themselves.

  • Fixed: Decontaminants couldn't be linked in the chat.

  • Fixed: Opening an object with linked storages would show "This object has no nearby storage" while the list was loading. It now shows "Loading nearby storages..." instead.

  • Improved: Storage lists with many linked storages now load significantly faster.

  • Improved: Civic check results in tooltips are now displayed in an easier to read format, so that the results of negated checks are no longer confusing.

Miscellaneous:

  • Fixed: Migration to Update 14 wouldn't remove all modules from all tables as was intended.

  • Fixed: The new singleplayer setting didn't correctly apply character experience being granted when specialty experience was gained.

  • Fixed: Painted blocks would sometimes show misplaced colors.

  • Fixed: Supporter bundles would be granted a second time when the server language was changed after the player had already joined the server.

  • Fixed: A race condition that would lead to a server crash.

  • Fixed: The shelf life multiplier being changed in the server ui didn't immediately reflect in the game.

  • Improved: The new singleplayer setting now sets the costs for all specialties to a single star.

Breathedge
Announcement
Breathedge Is Free to Keep for 48 Hours!

Greetings, comrades! There’s very little time left before Breathedge 2 enters Early Access, and we’re ready to present the game’s launch trailer! A real one, too—with the Man, the Chicken, outer space, and jokes that somehow manage to sink below rock bottom.

Alongside this masterpiece of auteur cinema, we’d also like to give you the first game—the one and only Breathedge. For free!

Maybe, by some miracle, you never got around to downloading it from a torrent. Maybe you want to explore its incredibly deep lore through the Man’s dialogue. Or maybe you simply collect games you’ll never play. Either way, this news is for you.

The original Breathedge will be free to keep on Steam starting August 7 at 10:00 AM Pacific (5:00 PM UTC). The giveaway will run for 48 hours, ending August 9 at 10:00 AM Pacific.

Grab it even if you have absolutely no use for it. It might come in handy someday.

Now, a quick update, since we’re already here.

We’re actively polishing Breathedge 2, fine-tuning tiny details, localizations, textures, and countless other little things that are really wearing down our ass…ets and our nerves of steel. So far, though, everything is going perfectly according to plan. Luckily, we don’t have one, or we’d definitely be behind schedule.

Overall, the game is completely finished and has been tested inside and out. It even works. Naturally, we’re certain you’ll manage to break it within the first ten seconds after launch, so the programmers are already stocking up on energy drinks. But that’s another story.

Besides the game itself, we’ve also started gently poking the Steam page with a stick: updating old text, materials, and assorted bits of capsule art. We’re trying to pass every certification, get everything working nicely on Steam Deck, cram the game anywhere it will fit, and tell everyone within reach. In other words, we’re going through the usual pre-release panic while awaiting your devastating reviews.

So, business as usual.

And if you have no interest in the game whatsoever and only opened this post looking for links to our social media, there they are—all the way down below. Message us, call us, send us videos.

You can even email us at  

https://info@breathedge.com

And, of course, you can wishlist Breathedge 2. There are only a few weeks left until launch, making this your final chance to wishlist Breathedge 2 before it comes out. After that, sadly, this opportunity will be gone FOREVER, and you’ll only be able to wishlist a game that has already been released. Don’t miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2412960/Breathedge_2
